definitions: To catch one's foot on something and stumble or fall.
To make someone stumble or fall by catching their foot.
To activate a mechanism, especially an electrical one, causing it to switch off.
To go on a journey or excursion, especially a short one.
examples: She might trip on that loose rug.
He tried to trip his opponent during the race.
The power will trip if you overload the circuit.
They plan to trip around Europe next summer.
